items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: Isaac Jefferson, piano; ... Dial Dyre was on drums; ... And I was on the trumpet.

ctx.x: Who else was in the band, do you recall?

Yeah. Isaac Jefferson, piano; Pat Powell, leader on clarinet; Dial Dyre was on drums; and, well, we had Lightfoot George Life at one time on saxophone, when Life left we had a boy by the name of [Swain] on the saxophone. And I was on the trumpet.
uh-huh. And what kind of tunes did you plan then? Did you play some blues by then?
